turns.content: That didn't work, and the reason is ordering, not caching. app/db.py calls get_settings() at module level to build `engine`, and pytest imports tests/conftest.py, which imports app.db, during collection, before any fixture runs. By the time test_env sets APP_ENV the engine is already bound to the dev URL, and clearing the settings cache does not rebuild it. Reverting the cache_clear and setting APP_ENV on the first lines of tests/conftest.py, above every app import.

input.new_string:
import os

os.environ["APP_ENV"] = "test"  # before any app import: app/db.py builds its engine at import time

import pytest

turns.content: CI stayed green because .github/workflows/test.yml sets APP_ENV: test for the whole job, so the variable already exists before pytest starts. Only local runs without APP_ENV exported hit the dev database.
